description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary and the opportunity to significantly impact patient care outcomes and staff development. We are looking for a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of clinical excellence and operational efficiency.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, manage and mentor nursing staff, develop and implement comprehensive care plans, and ensure strict adherence to regulatory compliance. You will foster a collaborative and supportive environment, driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the quality of care provided. If you are a passionate Registered Nurse with proven leadership capabilities and a commitment to compassionate care, we encourage you to apply promptly to join our team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Proven leadership and management skills within a healthcare setting
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and compliance standards
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational abilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
